title: Finish development before attacking
summary: Bring out the king-side knight, castle when safe, and support the centre.

fromNode.nodeId: e4 e5 Nc3 Bc5 Bc4 Nf6

goal: Bring out the king-side knight, castle when safe, and support the centre.

steps.text: Develop the king-side knight to support central play.
Castle only when the path is clear and the king will not pass through check.
Support the e4 pawn and bring out the remaining bishop before committing to an attack.

jobs.text: The knight controls e4 and d5 from here.
The bishop controls d5 from here.
The pawn controls d5 from here.

opponent.text: Black can develop the f6 knight to attack the e4 pawn. Count the defenders before choosing a pawn break.

notNow: Do not sacrifice the active bishop just because it points toward the king-side.

mistakes.text: Moving the bishop to a6 leaves it capturable by the b7 pawn. Do not sacrifice it without a concrete follow-up.

comments.text: Bring your knight to f3. From f3 it controls d4 and e5. Keep watching Black's replies before advancing more pawns.
Castle short. The king leaves the centre and the rook comes to f1; finish developing before starting an attack.
Bring your pawn to d3. From d3 it controls e4. Keep watching Black's replies before advancing more pawns.
Bring your pawn to a4. Keep your pieces working together and check the opponent's threats before the next move.
